controls.description: Personal data processed only for complaint management purposes.
controls.control_implemented: Data collection limited to complaint-related fields; no secondary processing.

controls.description: Data collected is adequate and relevant to complaint investigation.
controls.control_implemented: Input form collects only necessary fields (title, description, council, category).

controls.description: Collection limited to minimum necessary for regulatory purpose.
controls.control_implemented: Anonymous submission supported; no mandatory PII beyond complaint text.

controls.description: Clear information about data processing purposes.
controls.control_implemented: Privacy notice in web UI; threat model publicly accessible via API.

controls.description: Technical and organizational measures to protect personal data.
controls.control_implemented: SHA-256 hash chaining, TLS in production, OWASP security headers, rate limiting, input sanitization.
Blockchain tamper-evidence; append-only audit log; external hash anchoring.

controls.description: Demonstrate compliance with data protection measures.
controls.control_implemented: STRIDE threat model; DPIA report; open-source code; replication package.

controls.description: Processing necessary for public administration duties.
controls.control_implemented: Professional councils are autarchic public bodies (Lei 9.696/1998); complaint processing is a legal duty.

controls.description: Security measures to protect personal data from unauthorized access.
controls.control_implemented: TLS transport encryption; content-security-policy headers; non-root service account deployment; HMAC-chained audit log.
All evidence transactions recorded in blockchain with timestamps; audit log tracks all operations.

controls.description: Data Protection Impact Assessment for high-risk processing.
controls.control_implemented: This DPIA report; threat model with 10 catalogued threats.

controls.description: Right to erasure of personal data.
controls.control_implemented: Blockchain by design is append-only; erasure of on-chain data conflicts with evidence integrity. Documented as non-guarantee. Off-chain PII can be redacted.
controls.residual_risk: Complaint text containing PII is stored on-chain and cannot be deleted without chain rewrite. Mitigation: anonymization of complaints encouraged in UI.

controls.description: Notification of data breaches to authority and data subjects.
controls.control_implemented: Security event logging in audit log; chain validation detects tampering. Incident notification procedure to be defined by deploying council.
controls.residual_risk: Automated breach notification to ANPD not implemented. Institutional procedure required.

residual_risks.residual_risk: Complaint text containing PII is stored on-chain and cannot be deleted without chain rewrite. Mitigation: anonymization of complaints encouraged in UI.

residual_risks.description: Notification of data breaches to authority and data subjects.
residual_risks.control_implemented: Security event logging in audit log; chain validation detects tampering. Incident notification procedure to be defined by deploying council.
residual_risks.residual_risk: Automated breach notification to ANPD not implemented. Institutional procedure required.

recommendations: Implement off-chain PII redaction mechanism for Art. 18 compliance.
Define incident notification procedure per Art. 48 with deploying council.
Conduct periodic DPIA review (annually or upon significant system change).
